front.title: Cryptographic Context Compaction Receipts, Sensitivity Label Inheritance, and Verifiable Right-to-Be-Forgotten Lineage for Agent Memory

abstract.t: Long-running autonomous AI agents periodically summarize, compact, and distill episodic interaction logs into persistent vector or graph memory stores. Lossy context compaction erases the cryptographic provenance of which source documents contributed to a compacted memory state, stripping enterprise sensitivity labels (DLP classifications) and making regulatory data-erasure mandates (GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure / CCPA purge) impossible to verify. This document specifies the Ephemeral Context Compaction Receipt (ECCR) protocol: a Merkle inclusion and label-ceiling receipt that preserves deterministic sensitivity inheritance and cryptographic purge verifiability across lossy memory compaction boundaries.
